en.t: Roman consul Aulus Manlius Vulso celebrates an ovation for concluding the war against Veii and securing a forty years' truce
en.s: The consuls were the two highest elected public officials of the Roman Republic (c. 509 BC to 27 BC). Romans considered the consulship the second-highest level of the cursus honorum—an ascending sequence of public offices to which politicians aspired—after that of the censor, which was reserved for former consuls. Each year, the centuriate assembly elected two consuls to serve jointly for a one-year term.

zh.t: 罗马执政官奥卢斯·曼利乌斯·乌尔索庆祝凯旋式：他结束了与维爱城的战争，并争取到40年休战
zh.s: 执政官是罗马共和国（约公元前509年至公元前27年）最高的两名民选公职人员。罗马人认为，执政官职位在荣誉官职序列中位居第二，仅次于监察官；政治家以逐级担任这一系列公职为目标，而监察官一职只授予前任执政官。百人队大会每年选出两名执政官，共同任职一年。

en.t: The Roman Republic under its new consuls Publius Sulpicius Galba and Gaius Aurelius Cotta declares war on Philip V of Macedon, starting the Second Macedonian War
en.s: The Roman Republic (Latin: Res publica Romana, pronounced [ˈreːs ˈpuːblɪka roːˈmaːna]) was the era of classical Roman civilisation beginning with the overthrow of the Roman Kingdom (traditionally dated to 509 BC) and ending in 27 BC with the establishment of the Roman Empire following the War of Actium. During this period, Rome's control expanded from the city's immediate surroundings to hegemony over the entire Mediterranean world.

zh.t: 新任执政官普布利乌斯·苏尔皮基乌斯·加尔巴和盖乌斯·奥里利乌斯·科塔代表罗马共和国向马其顿国王腓力五世宣战，第二次马其顿战争由此爆发
zh.s: 罗马共和国（拉丁语：Res publica Romana，读作[ˈreːs ˈpuːblɪka roːˈmaːna]）是古典罗马文明的一个时期，传统上以公元前509年推翻罗马王政为开端，至公元前27年阿克提乌姆战争后罗马帝国建立而结束。在此期间，罗马的控制范围从城市周边扩展到整个地中海地区，并取得霸权。

en.s: The Battle of Riade, also called Battle of Merseburg or Battle at the Unstrut, was fought between the troops of East Francia under King Henry I and the Magyars at an unidentified location in northern Thuringia along the river Unstrut on 15 March 933. The battle was precipitated by the decision of the Synod of Erfurt to stop paying an annual tribute to the Magyars in 932.

zh.s: 里亚德之战又称梅泽堡之战或翁斯特鲁特河之战，发生于933年3月15日。东法兰克国王亨利一世率军与马扎尔人交战，地点位于图林根北部翁斯特鲁特河沿岸，但具体位置不详。932年，埃尔福特宗教会议决定停止向马扎尔人缴纳年度贡赋，战斗因此爆发。

en.s: Dom Afonso I (born Afonso Henriques; 1106/1109/1111 – 6 December 1185) nicknamed "the Conqueror" (Portuguese: O Conquistador), "the Founder" (O Fundador) and "the Great" (O Magno) by the Portuguese, was the first king of Portugal, from 26 July 1139 until his death on 6 December 1185. He achieved the independence of the County of Portugal, establishing a new kingdom and doubling its area with the Reconquista, an objective that he pursued until his death.

zh.t: 葡萄牙的阿方索一世出其不意地从穆拉比特王朝手中夺取圣塔伦
zh.s: 葡萄牙的阿方索一世（原名阿方索·恩里克斯；1106年／1109年／1111年—1185年12月6日）是葡萄牙首位国王，从1139年7月26日在位至1185年12月6日去世。葡萄牙人称他为“征服者”（葡萄牙语：O Conquistador）、“奠基者”（O Fundador）和“伟大者”（O Magno）。他实现了葡萄牙伯国独立，建立新王国，并通过收复失地运动将其领土扩大一倍；他直到去世前一直致力于此。

en.s: The Battle of Halmyros, known by older scholars as the Battle of the Cephissus or Battle of Orchomenos, was fought on 15 March 1311 between the forces of the Frankish Duchy of Athens and its vassals under Walter of Brienne and the mercenaries of the Catalan Company, resulting in a devastating victory for the Catalans. Engaged in conflict with their original employers, the Byzantine Empire, the Catalan Company had traversed the southern Balkans and arrived in southern Greece in 1309. The new Duke of Athens, Walter of Brienne, hired them to attack the Greek ruler of neighbouring Thessaly.

zh.s: 哈尔米罗斯战役于1311年3月15日发生，交战双方为布里耶讷的沃尔特率领的法兰克人雅典公国及其附庸军队，与加泰罗尼亚佣兵团，后者取得压倒性胜利。早期学者也称此战为刻菲索斯河战役或奥尔霍迈诺斯战役。加泰罗尼亚佣兵团与原雇主拜占庭帝国发生冲突后，穿过巴尔干半岛南部，于1309年抵达希腊南部。新任雅典公爵沃尔特随后雇用他们，进攻邻近色萨利的希腊统治者。

en.s: Treaty of Lubowla of 1412 was a treaty between Władysław II, King of Poland, and Sigismund of Luxemburg, King of Hungary. Negotiations took place in the town of Lublo (today Stará Ľubovňa, Slovakia) and a treaty confirmed later that year in Buda.

zh.s: 1412年的卢博夫拉条约由波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫二世与匈牙利国王卢森堡的西吉斯蒙德签订。双方在卢布洛（今斯洛伐克旧卢博夫尼亚）谈判，条约于当年晚些时候在布达得到确认。

en.s: The Adana campaign occurred after Ottoman forces seized the city of Adana from the Mamluk Sultanate. The Mamluks responded by sending a force under Commander and Chief Uzbek, and besieged Adana. The Ottomans responded by sending a large relief force that was defeated.

en.t: Mughal Emperor Akbar abolishes the jizya tax on non-Muslim subjects
en.s: Dhimmī (Arabic: ذمي ḏimmī, "protected person", IPA: [ˈðimmiː], collectively أهل الذمة ʾahl aḏ-ḏimmah/dhimmah, "protected people") is a historical term for non-Muslims living in an Islamic state with certain legal protections and restrictions. The word literally means "protected person", referring to the state's obligation under sharia to protect the individual's life, property, as well as freedom of religion, in exchange for loyalty to the state and payment of the jizya tax, in contrast to the zakat, or obligatory alms, paid by the Muslim subjects.

zh.t: 莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴废除针对非穆斯林臣民征收的吉兹亚税
zh.s: “齐米”（阿拉伯语：ذمي ḏimmī，意为“受保护者”；国际音标：[ˈðimmiː]；复数形式 أهل الذمة ʾahl aḏ-ḏimmah/dhimmah，意为“受保护的人群”）是历史术语，指生活在伊斯兰国家、享有某些法律保护但也受到限制的非穆斯林。这个词字面意思是“受保护者”，指国家依据伊斯兰教法负有保护其生命、财产和宗教自由的义务；作为交换，他们须效忠国家并缴纳吉兹亚税。穆斯林臣民则缴纳天课，即法定施舍。

en.s: The siege of Chartres (28 February – 15 March 1568) was a key event of the second French Wars of Religion. The siege saw the Huguenot forces fail to take the heavily defended town, ultimately concluding the second civil war in a negotiated settlement a week later. One of the very few engagements in the second civil war, the siege was led by Louis, Prince of Condé, fresh off regrouping after his defeat at the Battle of Saint-Denis.

zh.s: 沙特尔围城战于1568年2月28日至3月15日进行，是第二次法国宗教战争中的关键事件。胡格诺派军队未能攻下防守严密的城镇；一周后，双方通过谈判达成协议，第二次内战由此结束。第二次内战期间交战很少，这次围城战由孔代亲王路易率领，他刚在圣但尼战役失利后重整队伍。

en.s: The 1626 Potosí flood was a major disaster in Charcas (present-day Bolivia) that led to estimates of 2,000 or 4,000 human deaths. On March 15, 1626, the San Ildefonso Dam burst causing a flood in the city of Potosí that destroyed many silver ore-processing plants (ingenios) and led to massive economical losses and environmental damages.

zh.s: 1626年波托西洪灾是查尔卡斯（今玻利维亚）的一场重大灾难，估计造成2000或4000人死亡。1626年3月15日，圣伊尔德丰索水坝决堤，洪水淹没波托西市，摧毁了许多银矿加工厂（ingenios），造成巨大的经济损失和环境破坏。

en.s: The Battle of Jarosław took place during the Deluge (part of the Second Northern War) in March 15, 1656. Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth forces under the command of Stefan Czarniecki defeated the Swedish forces commanded by Charles X Gustav of Sweden. After the Battle of Golab, the Swedish army under King Charles X Gustav marched towards Lwow, where Polish forces concentrated, and where King Jan Kazimierz stayed. In early March 1656, Charles X Gustav received news that up to 20,000 Polish-Lithuanian soldiers concentrated in Red Ruthenia. The Swedish King realized that his forces were not adequate to face the enemy, so he ordered a retreat towards the San river.

zh.s: 雅罗斯瓦夫战役于1656年3月15日发生在‘大洪水时代’，属于第二次北方战争。斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基指挥的波兰立陶宛联邦军队，击败瑞典国王卡尔十世·古斯塔夫率领的瑞军。戈翁布战役后，瑞军向波军集结、国王扬·卡齐米日驻留的利沃夫推进。1656年3月初，卡尔十世得知多达20,000名波兰立陶宛士兵已在红鲁塞尼亚集结，意识到己方兵力不足以应战，遂下令向桑河撤退。

en.s: The Declaration of Indulgence was Charles II of England's attempt to extend religious liberty to Protestant nonconformists and Roman Catholics in his realms, by suspending the execution of the Penal Laws that punished recusants from the Church of England. Charles issued the Declaration on 15 March 1672.

zh.s: 英格兰国王查理二世于1672年3月15日发布《宽容宣言》，试图暂停惩罚英格兰国教会异见者的刑法，从而扩大其治下新教非国教徒和罗马天主教徒的宗教自由。

en.s: The Raid on Haverhill was a military engagement that took place on March 15, 1697 during King William's War. Ordered by Louis de Buade de Frontenac, Governor General of New France, French, Algonquin, and Abenaki warriors descended on Haverhill, then a small frontier community in the Province of Massachusetts Bay. In the surprise attack, the Abenaki killed 27 colonists and took 13 captive.

zh.s: 哈弗希尔突袭是威廉王战争期间的一场军事行动，发生于1697年3月15日。新法兰西总督路易·德·布阿德·德·弗龙特纳克下令，法国、阿尔冈昆和阿贝纳基战士突袭马萨诸塞湾省当时一个小型边疆社区哈弗希尔。阿贝纳基人在突然袭击中杀死27名殖民者，并俘虏13人。

en.s: The Siege of Nice took place between 15 March 1705 and 4 January 1706 as part of the War of the Spanish Succession. It pitched the forces of Louis XIV of France against those of Victor Amadeus II of Savoy – the latter were led by the marquis of Caraglio.

zh.s: 尼斯围城战于1705年3月15日至1706年1月4日进行，是西班牙王位继承战争的一部分。法国路易十四的军队，与萨伏依的维托里奥·阿梅迪奥二世所属军队交战，后者由卡拉廖侯爵指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Guilford Court House was a battle fought on March 15, 1781, at a site which is now in Greensboro, the county seat of Guilford County, North Carolina, during the American Revolutionary War. A 2,100-man British force under the command of Lieutenant General Charles Cornwallis defeated Major General Nathanael Greene's 4,500 Americans. The British Army, however, lost a considerable number of men during the battle with estimates as high as 27%. Such heavy British casualties resulted in a strategic victory for the Americans. The battle was the “largest and most hotly contested” battle of the American Revolution’s southern campaign and led to the surrender of Cornwallis at Yorktown.

zh.s: 1781年3月15日，美国独立战争期间，双方在今北卡罗来纳州吉尔福德县县城格林斯伯勒的一处地点交战。查尔斯·康沃利斯中将率领2,100名英军，击败纳撒尼尔·格林少将率领的4,500名美军。不过，英军自身损失惨重，估计伤亡比例高达27%，使美军在战略上取得胜利。这是独立战争南方战役中规模最大、争夺最激烈的一战，并促成康沃利斯后来在约克镇投降。

en.s: George Washington (February 22, 1732 [O.S. February 11, 1731] – December 14, 1799) was a Founding Father and the first president of the United States, serving from 1789 to 1797. As commander of the Continental Army, Washington led Patriot forces to victory in the American Revolutionary War against the British Empire. He is commonly known as the Father of His Country for his role in bringing about American independence.

zh.t: 乔治·华盛顿在纽约州纽堡发表动情演说，劝军官不要支持纽堡阴谋；劝说奏效，原本受到威胁的政变没有发生
zh.s: 乔治·华盛顿（1732年2月22日〔儒略历1731年2月11日〕—1799年12月14日）是美国开国元勋，也是美国首任总统，任期为1789年至1797年。作为大陆军总司令，他率领爱国者军队在美国独立战争中击败大英帝国。他因促成美国独立而被尊称为“国父”。

en.s: The Battle of Foz de Arouce was an engagement of the Peninsular War which took place on 15 March 1811 between Anglo-Portuguese forces under Arthur Wellesley (later the Duke of Wellington) and French troops under the command of Marshal Michel Ney.

en.s: The siege of Monemvasia was a military engagement of the Greek War of Independence, aimed at liberating Monemvasia, shortly before the outbreak of the revolution. It lasted from 15 March to 23 July 1821. According to F. Chrysanthopoulos (Fotakos), the siege began after 25 March.

en.s: The University of Toronto (U of T) is a public research university with three main campuses in the Greater Toronto Area of Ontario, Canada. Based on the grounds that surround Queen's Park in Toronto, it was founded by royal charter in 1827 as King's College, the first institution of higher learning in Upper Canada. Originally controlled by the Church of England, the university assumed its present name in 1850 upon becoming a secular institution.

zh.s: 多伦多大学是加拿大安大略省大多伦多地区的一所公立研究型大学，设有三个主要校区。学校位于多伦多皇后公园周边，1827年以“国王学院”之名获皇家特许状成立，是上加拿大第一所高等教育机构。它最初由英格兰教会管理；1850年成为世俗机构后，改用现名。

en.s: Gubernatorial elections were held in El Salvador (then a part of the Federal Republic of Central America) on 15 March 1835. Liberal Nicolás Espinoza was elected governor, and the Legislative Assembly reaffirmed his victory on 6 April 1835. Espinoza assumed office on 10 April 1835.

en.s: The Broadway expedition was a British military expedition that explored the Broadway River (present-day Xi River) in Guangdong province, China, on 13–15 March 1841 during the First Opium War. en.s: The March Revolution was a military uprising that took place in Venezuela in March 1858. It was the first armed rebellion that managed to overthrow a government in Venezuelan history. The principal leader, the caudillo Julián Castro, was trusted absolutely by President José Tadeo Monagas. The main drivers of the movement were the social issues and political abuse which had accumulated during the Monagato or Liberal Oligarchy – a decade in which the brothers José Tadeo Monagas and José Gregorio Monagas ruled (1847–1858).

en.s: The Lobau bombing was a bomb attack in Paris, France, carried out on 15 March 1892, by the anarchist militant Théodule Meunier against the Lobau barracks. Organized four days after the Saint-Germain bombing, it was one of the first attacks of the Ère des attentats (1892–1894). The explosion caused material damage in the surrounding area but killed or injured no one. Meunier managed to carry out the Véry bombing a month later before fleeing to the United Kingdom. He was subsequently extradited to France, sentenced to life imprisonment with hard labor, and deported to the penal colony of Cayenne, where he died.

zh.s: 1892年3月15日，无政府主义活动人士泰奥迪勒·默尼耶在法国巴黎对洛博兵营发动炸弹袭击。袭击发生于圣日耳曼爆炸案四天之后，是1892至1894年法国‘袭击时代’最早的袭击之一。爆炸使周边财物受损，但无人死伤。默尼耶一个月后又实施韦里爆炸案，随后逃往英国。他后来被引渡回法国，判处终身苦役，并流放至卡宴流放地，最终死于当地。

en.s: The Madeleine bombing was a bomb attack carried out on 15 March 1894 by the anarchist militant Désiré Pauwels at the Madeleine church, facing the French National Assembly in Paris. zh.s: 1894年3月15日，无政府主义活动人士德西雷·保韦尔斯在巴黎正对法国国民议会的玛德莱娜教堂实施炸弹袭击。事件发生在1892至1894年‘袭击时代’的后半段，目的是打击天主教会的象征，以及巴黎资产阶级的一座主要教堂。

en.t: Tsar Nicholas II of Russia abdicates the Russian throne, ending the 304-year Romanov dynasty
en.s: Nicholas II (Nikolai Alexandrovich Romanov; 18 May [O.S. 6 May] 1868 – 17 July 1918) was Emperor of Russia from 1 November 1894 until his abdication in 1917. zh.t: 俄罗斯沙皇尼古拉二世退位，结束延续304年的罗曼诺夫王朝
zh.s: 尼古拉二世（尼古拉·亚历山德罗维奇·罗曼诺夫；1868年5月18日〔儒略历5月6日〕—1918年7月17日）自1894年11月1日起担任俄罗斯皇帝，直至1917年退位。他是俄国革命前的最后一位君主，并领导俄罗斯帝国参与第一次世界大战。1918年，罗曼诺夫家族遭到杀害，王朝就此终结。

en.s: The Battle of Tampere was a 1918 Finnish Civil War battle, fought in Tampere, Finland from 15 March to 6 April between the Whites and the Reds. It is the most famous and deadly of all the Finnish Civil War battles. Its bloody aftermath saw the Whites execute hundreds of captured Reds with another 11,000 prisoners sent to the Kalevankangas camp.

zh.t: 乌克兰独立战争：乌克兰革命起义军成立反情报部门“Kontrrazvedka”
zh.s: 乌克兰独立战争在乌克兰也称乌克兰—苏联战争，从1917年3月持续至1921年11月，是更广泛的俄国内战的一部分。战争期间，独立的乌克兰共和国得以建立并发展；其大部分领土于1919年至1920年间被并入乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国。

en.s: The American Legion, commonly known as the Legion, is an organization of U.S. veterans headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. It comprises state, U.S. territory, and overseas departments, in turn made up of local posts. It was established in March 1919 in Paris, France, by officers and men of the American Expeditionary Forces (AEF). It was subsequently chartered by the 66th U.S. Congress on September 16, 1919.

zh.t: 美国退伍军人协会成立
zh.s: 美国退伍军人协会（常简称“军团”）是一个总部设在印第安纳州印第安纳波利斯的美国退伍军人组织。它由各州、美国领地和海外分会组成，各分会下设地方基层组织。1919年3月，美国远征军的军官和士兵在法国巴黎成立了该组织。随后，美国国会于1919年9月16日通过法案，授予该组织特许状。

en.s: On 15 March 1921, Armenian student Soghomon Tehlirian killed Talaat Pasha—former grand vizier of the Ottoman Empire and the main architect of the Armenian genocide—in Berlin. zh.s: 1921年3月15日，亚美尼亚学生索戈蒙·泰赫利里安在柏林杀死塔拉特帕夏。塔拉特曾任奥斯曼帝国大维齐尔，也是亚美尼亚种族灭绝的主要策划者。庭审中，泰赫利里安辩称：‘我杀了一个人，但我不是杀人犯。’陪审团判他无罪。泰赫利里安来自奥斯曼帝国的埃尔津詹，但在战前已迁往塞尔维亚。

en.s: The Dagestan uprising of 1920–1921 was an event during the Russian Civil War. By the spring of 1920, Bolshevik forces controlled most of the Caucasus except Georgia. en.t: Carpatho-Ukraine declares itself an independent republic, but is annexed by Hungary the next day
en.s: Carpatho-Ukraine or Carpathian Ukraine (Ukrainian: Карпа́тська Украї́на, romanized: Karpatska Ukraina, IPA: [kɐrˈpɑtsʲkɐ ʊkrɐˈjinɐ]) was an autonomous region within the Second Czechoslovak Republic and short-lived state. It was created in December 1938 and renamed from Subcarpathian Rus', whose full administrative and political autonomy had been confirmed by constitutional law of 22 November 1938. 20 years earlier, by the 1920 Treaty of Trianon, the region, which had historically belonged to Hungary, had been detached from the Kingdom of Hungary and attached to newly created Czechoslovakia.

zh.t: 喀尔巴阡乌克兰宣布成为独立共和国，次日即被匈牙利吞并
zh.s: 喀尔巴阡乌克兰（乌克兰语：Карпа́тська Украї́на，转写：Karpatska Ukraina，国际音标：[kɐrˈpɑtsʲkɐ ʊkrɐˈjinɐ]）是第二捷克斯洛伐克共和国境内的一个自治地区，也是一个短命国家。它于1938年12月成立，名称取代外喀尔巴阡罗斯；根据1938年11月22日的宪法性法律，该地区的行政和政治自治得到充分确认。20年前，按照1920年《特里亚农条约》，这个历史上属于匈牙利的地区脱离匈牙利王国，划归新成立的捷克斯洛伐克。

en.s: Operation Spring Awakening (German: Unternehmen Frühlingserwachen) was the last major German offensive of World War II. The operation was referred to in Germany as the Plattensee Offensive and in the Soviet Union as the Balaton Defensive Operation. It took place in Western Hungary on the Eastern Front and lasted from 6 March until 15 March 1945.

en.s: Elections were held in the state of Western Australia on 15 March 1947 to elect all 50 members to the Legislative Assembly. The result was a hung parliament—the four-term Labor government, led by Premier Frank Wise, was defeated with a swing of approximately 7%. The Liberal-Country Coalition won exactly half of the seats, one short of a majority, needed the support of the Independent members Harry Shearn and William Read to govern.

en.s: Presidential and vice presidential elections were held in South Korea on 15 March 1960. Shortly after winning reelection to a second term in the 1952 presidential election, Rhee had the legislature pass a constitutional amendment exempting himself from the two-term limit, allowing himself to run for and win a third term in 1956 and in March 1960.

en.s: The Constitution of 1961 (formally the Republic of South Africa Constitution Act, 1961) was the fundamental law of South Africa for two decades. Under the terms of the constitution South Africa ceased to be a Commonwealth realm and became a republic, until rejoining the Commonwealth of Nations in 1994. Legally, the Union of South Africa, which had existed since 1910, came to an end and was re-established as the "Republic of South Africa".
en.n: At the 1961 Commonwealth Prime Ministers' Conference, South Africa announces that it will withdraw from the Commonwealth when the South African Constitution of 1961 comes into effect.

zh.s: 《1961年宪法》正式名称为《1961年南非共和国宪法法》，是南非约20年的根本法。根据宪法，南非不再是英联邦王国并改为共和国，直到1994年重新加入英联邦。法律上，自1910年起存在的南非联邦就此终结，并重组为“南非共和国”。
zh.n: 在1961年英联邦总理会议上，南非宣布1961年宪法生效后将退出英联邦。

en.s: The Battle of Togoruba took place on 15 March 1964, and was the first battle of the Eritrean War of Independence which involved the Ethiopian military instead of a police unit. While both sides claimed types of success—the insurgents for their political endurance and the government for tactical dominance—historical consensus confirms the Ethiopian army decisively won the battlefield engagement.

zh.s: 林登·贝恩斯·约翰逊（1908年8月27日—1973年1月22日），也称LBJ，1963年至1969年担任美国第36任总统。1961年起，他担任约翰·F·肯尼迪的副总统；肯尼迪于1963年遇刺后，约翰逊接任总统。在担任副总统之前，他曾作为民主党成员代表得克萨斯州，在美国国会两院任职。

en.s: On 15 March 1974, Sterling Airways Flight 901, a Sud Aviation Caravelle operated by Sterling Airways, experienced a landing gear failure as it was taxiing for take-off. The right main landing gear collapsed, which caused the right wing to contact the runway, rupturing a fuel tank and igniting the spilt fuel. The fire killed 15 passengers and injured 37 passengers and crew.

zh.t: 斯特林航空901号班机事故
zh.s: 1974年3月15日，斯特林航空901号班机（一架由斯特林航空运营的法国航空工业卡拉维尔客机）在滑行准备起飞时起落架故障。右侧主起落架折断，机翼擦到跑道，油箱破裂，泄漏的燃油起火。事故造成15名乘客死亡，另有37名乘客和机组人员受伤。

en.t: Somalia and Ethiopia sign a truce to end the Ethio-Somali War
en.s: The Ogaden War, also known as the Ethio-Somali War (Somali: Dagaalkii Xoraynta Soomaali Galbeed, Amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ሶማሊያ ጦርነት, romanized: ye’ītiyop’iya somalīya t’orinet), was a military conflict between Somalia and Ethiopia fought from July 1977 to March 1978 over control of the sovereignty of the Ogaden region. Somalia launched an invasion in support of the Western Somali Liberation Front (WSLF) insurgency, triggering a broader inter-state war.

zh.t: 埃塞俄比亚—索马里战争停战
zh.s: 奥加登战争也称埃塞俄比亚—索马里战争（索马里语：Dagaalkii Xoraynta Soomaali Galbeed；阿姆哈拉语：የኢትዮጵያ ሶማሊያ ጦርነት，转写：ye’ītiyop’iya somalīya t’orinet），是索马里和埃塞俄比亚为争夺奥加登地区主权而进行的一场军事冲突，持续时间为1977年7月至1978年3月。索马里为支持西索马里解放阵线的叛乱而发动入侵，引发了更大范围的两国战争。

en.s: The Herat uprising (Pashto: د هرات پاڅون, Dari: قیام هرات), locally known as the Uprising of 24th Hūt (Pashto: د ۲۴م کب پاڅون, Dari: قیام ۲۴م حوت), was an insurrection that took place in and around the city of Herat in western Afghanistan, across several days in March 1979. It included both a popular uprising and a mutiny of ethnic Tajik Afghan Army troops against the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan (DRA).

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Central African Republic on 15 March 1981. They were the first national elections of any sort since 1964, the first elections since the overthrow of longtime ruler Jean-Bédel Bokassa in 1979, and the first multiparty presidential elections since independence. Five candidates—David Dacko, Ange-Félix Patassé, François Pehoua, Henri Maïdou and Abel Goumba—ran for the election. The elections were won by Dacko, who had been restored back to the Presidency as part of Operation Barracuda, which overthrew Emperor Jean-Bédel Bokassa. Dacko tried to pose as the inheritor of Barthélemy Boganda, the national hero who founded the country.

zh.s: 中非共和国于1981年3月15日举行总统选举。这是1964年以来首次全国性选举，也是1979年长期统治者让-贝德尔·博卡萨被推翻后的首次选举，以及独立后的首次多党总统选举。五名候选人为戴维·达科、安热-费利克斯·帕塔塞、弗朗索瓦·佩乌阿、亨利·迈杜和阿贝尔·贡巴。达科获胜。他此前在推翻博卡萨皇帝的‘梭鱼行动’中恢复总统职位，并试图将自己塑造成建国民族英雄巴泰勒米·波冈达的继承者。

en.s: Operation Dawn-10 or Walfajr-10 (Persian: عملیات والفجر ۱۰) was an offensive operation launched by Iran against Iraq on March 15, 1988, near the end of the Iran–Iraq War. Led by the Pasdaran and supported by some regular army forces, the five-phase operation marked a shift in Iranian focus from southern to northern Iraq.

en.t: Mikhail Gorbachev is elected as the first and only President of the Soviet Union
en.s: Mikhail Sergeyevich Gorbachev (2 March 1931 – 30 August 2022) was a Soviet and Russian politician who was the last leader of the Soviet Union from 1985 until the country's dissolution in 1991. en.s: Regional elections were held in France on 15 March 1998. en.s: The 2002 CAF Super Cup was the tenth CAF Super Cup, an annual football match in Africa organized by the Confederation of African Football (CAF), between the winners of the previous season's two CAF club competitions, the African Cup of Champions Clubs and the African Cup Winners' Cup. The match took place on 15 March 2002, on Cairo International Stadium in Cairo, Egypt, between Al Ahly, the 2001 CAF Champions League winner, and Kaizer Chiefs, the 2001 African Cup Winners' Cup winner.

en.s: The 2008 Brisbane City Council election was held on 15 March 2008 to elect a lord mayor and 26 councillors to the City of Brisbane. The election resulted in the re-election of Campbell Newman of the Liberal Party as Lord Mayor, defeating Labor's Greg Rowell in a landslide with 66.1% of the mayoral two-party-preferred vote.

en.s: The 2008 Gold Coast City Council election was held on 15 March 2008 to elect a mayor and 14 councillors to the City of Gold Coast. The election was held as part of the statewide local elections in Queensland, Australia. en.s: The 2008 Townsville City Council election was held on 15 March 2008 to elect a mayor and 12 councillors to the City of Townsville. The election was held as part of the statewide local elections in Queensland, Australia. The election saw the Australian Labor Party, which had controlled the council for 32 years − the longest-serving Labor administration in Australia − defeated in a landslide by the conservative Team Tyrell, which won all but one of the councillor positions.

en.s: The Rey de Reyes 2009 (Spanish for "King of Kings") was a major annual professional wrestling show that also hosted that year's version of the Rey de Reyes tournament, produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA). en.s: The 2016 Gainesville, Florida mayoral election took place on March 15, 2016. Incumbent Mayor Ed Braddy ran for re-election to a second term. en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Myanmar on 15 March 2016, after the 2015 general election. en.s: On 15 March 2019, two consecutive terrorist mass shootings took place in Christchurch, New Zealand. They were committed during Friday prayer, first at the Al Noor Mosque in Riccarton at 1:40 p.m., and shortly afterwards at 1:52 p.m. at the Linwood Islamic Centre. en.s: The 2022 Fort McMurray-Lac La Biche by-election took place on March 15, 2022. The seat was left vacant on August 15, 2021, when incumbent MLA Laila Goodridge resigned to run in that year's federal election as the Conservative candidate in the riding of Fort McMurray—Cold Lake. The by-election was won by former MLA Brian Jean of the United Conservative Party, who previously led the Wildrose Party before its merger with the Progressive Conservative Association of Alberta in 2017.
